content: This document provides a summary of information about a specific product but does not include all possible details. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your use. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice and should not replace the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all potential drug interactions. It is important to maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter medications, and herbal supplements, and share this list with your doctor and pharmacist. If someone overdoses on this medication and experiences severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. For less urgent cases, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. This medication has been prescribed specifically for your current condition and should not be used for other purposes unless directed by your doctor. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature. Do not dispose of it by flushing it down the toilet or pouring it into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard the product when it is expired or no longer needed. The information provided here was last updated in May 2024. It is intended for general informational and educational purposes only. Individual plans and formulary information may vary and are subject to change.
